name: mrrobot
description: Multi-agent orchestrator in TypeScript: turns a goal into a task DAG, runs it with Codex, Claude, DeepSeek and LM Studio in isolated Git worktrees, and reviews the result.

scripts.test: MRROBOT_LOG_DIR=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/mrrobot-test-logs tsx --test --test-isolation=none src/agents/*.test.ts src/config/*.test.ts src/workspace/*.test.ts src/scheduler/*.test.ts src/storage/*.test.ts src/sandbox/*.test.ts src/harness/*.test.ts src/planner/*.test.ts src/grill/*.test.ts src/reviewer/*.test.ts src/supervisor/*.test.ts src/projects/*.test.ts src/chats/*.test.ts src/graph/*.test.ts src/api/*.test.ts src/preview/*.test.ts src/tasks/*.test.ts src/checks/*.test.ts src/providers/*.test.ts
